payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test used a pattern anchored with a leading `^`, so `re.match` and `re.search` behave identically with it and the mutation was unreachable. I removed the leading `^` from the pattern (re.match still anchors at position 0 on its own, so this changes nothing under the real code) and added a case with a detail that names "AssertionError" later in its text, asserting it still reads raised, proving the pattern decides and core special-cases no word.
